items.headline: OpenAI details Performance Factory system for ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI has shared details on how it built the Performance Factory. The system uses Codex-powered workflows to find and fix performance issues to keep ChatGPT fast.
items.why_it_matters: The system helps maintain performance speeds for ChatGPT by automating fixes.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

items.headline: Simon Willison introduces external sandboxes for coding agents
items.summary: Simon Willison, in collaboration with Prime Radiant, has introduced the external sandbox pattern for AI coding agents. Three sandbox server implementations were released to run agent-executed code inside a dedicated environment.
items.why_it_matters: Sandboxing aims to mitigate risks from mistakes or prompt injection attacks on host machines.
items.evidence_quote: To demonstrate this pattern we've released three sandbox server implementations

items.headline: Google Gemini app for macOS adds computer use feature
items.summary: Google has added a computer use feature to its Gemini app for macOS. The tool aids users in completing multi-step tasks across local files, desktop applications, and the web.
items.why_it_matters: The tool expands Gemini's desktop utility to automate actions directly on macOS.
items.evidence_quote: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files

items.headline: Anthropic begins trading on Nasdaq following initial public offering
items.summary: Anthropic has officially gone public, listing on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT. The stock opened trading at $111.50 per share, above its initial price of $83 per share, which had valued the firm at approximately $1.5 trillion.
items.why_it_matters: The debut marks a major public market listing for an artificial intelligence developer.
items.evidence_quote: Anthropic has officially gone public. It began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share
